original_value: Dancing is an activity that positively enhances the mood of people that consists of feeling the music and expressing it in rhythmic movements with the body. Learning how to dance can be challenging because it requires proper coordination and understanding of rhythm and beat. In this paper, we present the first implementation of the Dancing Coach (DC), a generic system designed to support the practice of dancing steps, which in its current state supports the practice of basic salsa dancing steps. However, the DC has been designed to allow the addition of more dance styles. We also present the first user evaluation of the DC, which consists of user tests with 25 participants. Results from the user test show that participants stated they had learned the basic salsa dancing steps, to move to the beat and body coordination in a fun way. Results also point out some direction on how to improve the future versions of the DC.

result.paraphrase: Dancing is an activity that can improve mood by feeling music and expressing it through rhythmic body movements. Learning to dance can be difficult because it requires proper coordination and an understanding of rhythm and beat. In this paper, we describe the first implementation of the Dancing Coach (DC), a generic system created to support practicing dance steps; in its current form, it supports basic salsa steps. The DC was designed so additional dance styles can be added. We also report the first user evaluation of the DC, based on tests with 25 participants. The user test results indicate that participants said they learned basic salsa steps, moving to the beat, and body coordination in a fun way. The results also suggest directions for improving future versions of the DC.
